children: Indian Hotels Company (IHCL) is marking the 10th World Wellness Weekend with a selection of wellness experiences across its hotels in Delhi NCR and Uttarakhand. The curated offerings range from riverside yoga and forest bathing in the hills to personalised therapies, contemporary beauty rituals and mindful movement in the capital region.

At Corbett Hideaway, Jim Corbett – IHCL SeleQtions, the seven-acre property by the Kosi River will host a wellness programme from September 18 to 20. The experience will include guided riverside yoga, detox water and Himalayan herbal teas featuring nettle, buransh, giloy, mint and basil. Set amid Corbett’s forested landscape, the programme is designed around time outdoors, local flavours and the calming presence of the river.

Naukuchia House, Naukuchiatal – IHCL SeleQtions will host a two-night Wellness Retreat this November. Set at 4,000 feet amid oak and pine forests overlooking Naukuchiatal Lake, the retreat will include lakeside yoga and meditation, guided forest bathing, Himalayan singing bowl sound healing, Facial Pilates and aromatherapy body massage using local essential oils. Guests can also experience Kumaoni herbal tea tasting around a courtyard bonfire and a wellness menu at IJA, shaped by a 20-mile sourcing philosophy. Packages start from rupee 20,000 plus taxes per room per night, with dates and reservations to be announced.

At Taj Mahal, New Delhi, the J Wellness Circle brings together Indian and international therapies, while the hotel’s green surroundings, pool, fitness centre and yoga offerings support a broader approach to wellbeing. Niu & Nau Salon will host Niu & Nau Afterglow: Janssen Longevity & Recovery Rituals on September 20 from 4:30 pm onwards. The experience will include personalised skin-booster rituals, restorative facial care, LED therapy, recovery tools, expert consultations and demonstrations.

Taj Palace, New Delhi will mark the occasion on September 19 with a wellness session in collaboration with Global Spa and GetWetFit. Held by the pool from 4 pm to 6 pm, the experience will feature Aqua Dance followed by an Ice Plunge. The session is priced at rupee 2,500 per person.

At Taj Palace Lucknow, J Wellness Circle draws on Ayurveda and Yoga through therapies including Nidra, Vishuddhi, Vishrama, Sushupti and Trupti, alongside traditional treatments such as Champi and Pada Mardana. The experiences focus on restoration, relaxation, muscular relief and renewed vitality.

Taj Surajkund Resort & Spa, Delhi NCR, located at the foothills of the Aravalli Range, will offer a close-to-the-city wellness escape. Its two-storey J Wellness Circle features personalised therapies and massages, alongside yoga, fitness, steam and sauna facilities. A curated Wellness Experience includes a 60-minute Indian aromatherapy therapy for couples, guided sunrise Surya Namaskar, wellness breakfasts and in-room sleep rituals. Guests can also engage with the resort’s natural setting through plantation activities, pottery sessions and sunset experiences.

Across the properties, the World Wellness Weekend offerings bring together nature, movement, traditional Indian wellness practices, contemporary therapies and regional experiences, extending IHCL’s focus on wellbeing across its hotels in the region.
